acquisition_method.evidence: In each cycle, 16 MS/MS spectra were acquired in a data-dependent manner using a 60 second exclusion window.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Carbamidomethylation of cysteine and oxidation of methionine were included as variable modifications.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Trypsin/P was specified as the proteolytic enzyme and maximum 2 missed cleavages were allowed.

enrichment_method.evidence: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics
